explication: PaddleHelix is a research toolkit of biomolecular machine-learning applications, rather than one end-user service. A representative workflow is protein sequence input, alignment and feature preparation, then structure prediction; the repository also contains separate tools for docking, molecular generation, affinity and synergy prediction, and molecular pretraining. The README documents these capabilities, while sampled source shows parts of the folding data pipeline. Other application internals and their runtime wiring are not sampled, so those links are omitted or marked unverified.
